correctness.rationale: All unrestricted instances reduce via an exact outdegree-semigroup equivalence and conductor argument to twelve explicitly enumerated finite bicliques, whose individual full orientation masks pass the standard-library independent arithmetic checker. The obstruction at degree-sum k²−2 is exact; no finite interpolation is used.

evidence: Lee (arXiv:2611.24973v1), sections 4.2–4.4 and Tables 2–3, proves general-multipartite sufficiency for k=3 and constructs tripartite obstructions for all k.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general-multipartite lower bound is not an upper bound for the biclique subclass. The new biclique thresholds are one below the tripartite obstruction degree-sum and require separately checked constructions.
